title: Shackles Breaking Dawn
next_chapter_hook: The voice of the Heavenly Secrets' Eye exploded in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, presenting him with an unrefusable contract—accept the manipulation of fate, or tear apart the black veil shrouding the destiny of all living beings at the cost of losing everything?

text.content: As the darkness receded like a tide, Ling Yuan's figure dissipated into the depths of the Void, leaving only a faint cold hum. Before Chen Ji could catch his breath, an ice-cold voice came rolling from the far reaches of the Void—the voice of the Demonic Path Commander, like nine netherworld cold iron scraping against the marrow, carrying the霸道 and contempt that could sweep through thousands of armies. "Tianqing Sect ant, do you think escaping Ling Yuan's chess game means you're free? Beyond the chessboard, there are still the Chess Players." Chen Ji gripped the fragment in his hand, his knuckles turning white, his heart trembling—fate's chess game was far grander than he had imagined.

The shackle patterns on the fourth page of the Tianji Record blazed frantically in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, each rune searing his divine soul. Agonizing pain surged wave after wave like tides, Chen Ji knelt on one knee, fine beads of cold sweat seeping from his temples. He could feel that invisible shackle tightening, like a venomous snake coiling in the depths of his soul, ready to strangle him at any moment. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul emerged from the book pages, a pale phantom hovering at Chen Ji's side, his eyes flickering with an unprecedented gravity: "Master, the shackle of the fourth page... it sensed the Heavenly Secrets power you leaked when resisting Ling Yuan, and is accelerating its devouring of your Heavenly Fate Value."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice was low and urgent: "Before Chen Xuan predecessor fell, he left a hidden measure—he sealed the key information to breaking the shackle within a certain ruin. That ruin only reveals its entrance at specific times, under specific star alignments. And tonight... is a once-in-a-century window." Chen Ji gritted his teeth and stood, a cold smile curling at the corner of his lips: "Once in a century? Ling Yuan just left, and the Demonic Commander's voice rings out—timing couldn't be more precise." He took a deep breath, a flash of determination掠过 his eyes, "Where is the ruin?"

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul transformed into a stream of light and entered Chen Ji's Brow Center, a illusory map unfolding slowly in his Mental Sea. It was a forbidden place deep within Tianqing Sect Back Mountain—"Chen Xuan's Ruin." Legend has it that Chen Xuan attained enlightenment and glimpsed the true mysteries of the Tianji Record right here. The ruin's entrance was hidden behind a waterfall, and the waterfall's flow only stopped at specific times, revealing that door that had been sealed for a thousand years. Chen Ji did not hesitate in the slightest, his figure turning into a afterimage as he rushed toward the Back Mountain. The night wind was biting like a knife,刮过他苍白的面庞, his heart holding only one thought: tonight, he must find the answer.

The waterfall was right before him, its roaring sound like thunder. Chen Ji stood at the cliff's edge, his eyes glowing faint golden in the night—that was the sign of the Tianji Record Fragment automatically operating. He saw: the waterfall would briefly stop in half an hour, and then the stone door would appear. However, at this moment, a凛冽 killing intent surged from behind! Chen Ji's body surged backward, a jet-black demonic blade chopped past his cheek, severing an ancient pine at its waist. The owner of the demonic blade—a Demonic Path scout in black robes emerged from the shadows, a残忍 smile hanging on his face: "Waste of a disciple, daring to trespass the Forbidden Grounds? The Demon Marshal has ordered, any Tianqing Sect disciple, execute on site!"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji looked at the demonic blade hovering in mid-air, then at the scout's arrogance bordering on foolishness, and suddenly let out a light laugh. "Execute on site?" He leisurely straightened his clothes, his voice平静得近乎温柔, "Do you know who I am?" The scout sneered: "A waste servant disciple, who else could you be?" Chen Ji raised his hand, the Tianji Record Fragment appearing in his palm, golden runes flowing like rivers. "Then do you know what this thing means in the Tianqing Sect?" The scout's pupils contracted sharply, the mask-like残忍 smile instantly frozen. Chen Ji did not say another word, his fingers lightly flicked, a golden glow containing three-hour foresight entering the scout's Brow Center—the next second, the scout saw the scene where he was pierced through the heart by Chen Ji's sword in three hours, his face pale as paper. "Scram." Chen Ji淡淡道, "Or, you can stay and verify."

text.content: The scout's body trembled, not from anger, but from bone-deep fear. He opened his mouth, but in the end couldn't utter a single word, turning into a wisp of black smoke and fleeing in panic. Chen Ji withdrew his fingers, feeling his Heavenly Fate Value drop another five points in his Mental Sea, his heart sinking slightly—his Heavenly Fate Value was now less than thirty, every foresight was透支 his life. Yet he had no choice. The waterfall's sound suddenly changed, the originally roaring current beginning to weaken,细微的停顿正在蔓延. Chen Ji's eyes lit up: the timing had arrived! His toes touched the ground, his body like a wild goose gliding over the water, passing through the gradually thinning water curtain—the stone door, slowly revealed under the moonlight.

The stone door was three zhang tall, entirely constructed from玄青色 star stones, its surface covered密密麻麻 with ancient runes. As Chen Ji approached, those runes all lit up simultaneously, golden light bursting from the stone crevices, interweaving into a massive formation diagram in the night sky. At the same moment, Chen Ji's fourth page shackle on his chest trembled violently, sending a splitting剧痛—those runes sealed on the stone door had produced some uncanny resonance with the shackle within his body. Chen Ji groaned, forcing himself to walk to the stone door, his right hand pressing against the密密麻麻 runes. In that instant, an old and familiar voice exploded in his Mental Sea—the voice of Chen Xuan, crossing a thousand years of time!

dialogue.content: Chen Xuan's voice was bleak and profound: "Successor, if you can hear this divine thought, it means you have reached the edge of the fourth page shackle. The Tianji Record has nine pages in total, each page bearing a Heavenly Dao shackle, used to bind the power of the prophet. The shackle is both protection and confinement—it allows you to glimpse Heavenly Secrets, yet also抽取 your Heavenly Fate after each glimpse, until you perish from exhaustion." Chen Ji held his breath. Chen Xuan's voice continued: "There is only one method to break the shackle—exchange complete prophetic ability as the price, to achieve the shackle's complete dissolution. But this means... you will forever lose the ability to foresee the future. The Tianji Record will become a scroll of blank heavens, and you will become an ordinary person."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. A bone-deep coldness crept from the soles of his feet to the top of his head—he took several breaths to digest the meaning of these words. Without the ability to foresee the future, what did he have to compete with Ling Yuan? What to protect Su Qingyao? What to find Chen Nian? And what to resist the yet-unseen Demonic Path Commander and the Heavenly Secrets' Eye? Without the Tianji Record, he would be a废物 unable to break through Foundation Building, a cannon fodder who couldn't survive three episodes in any sect. However, at this moment, the Tianji Record itself spoke for the first time—a sound indescribable by language, like countless stars whispering in unison, ancient, remote, transcending all cause and effect.

dialogue.content: The Tianji Record's voice echoed in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, each word like a heavy hammer striking his divine soul: "Chen Ji." This was the first time the Tianji Record directly addressed his name, "The shackle is not a shackle." Chen Ji's whole body shook, he blurted out: "What do you mean?" The Tianji Record's voice was terrifyingly calm: "The true function of the fourth page shackle is to bind your Heavenly Fate Value to my operation. Every time you use foresight ability, you consume not only Heavenly Fate Value, but also part of my body's rule power. The shackle extracts all this, transporting it toward some... higher existence." Chen Ji's blood nearly froze: "You mean... someone is汲取 strength from me through the shackle?" The Tianji Record was silent for a moment, then uttered four words Chen Ji would never forget—"Heavenly Secrets' Eye."

choice.prompt: The true face of the Heavenly Secrets' Eye shocked Chen Ji profoundly, at this moment two entirely different paths appeared before him—one leading to complete freedom and power return, the other preserving the last spark of prophecy to deal with the immediate crisis. He had to make a choice.

choices.description: Accept Chen Xuan's inheritance, at the cost of losing all prophetic ability, sever the connection with the Heavenly Secrets' Eye. Escape control, but forever become a true废物.
choices.visible_cost: Permanently lose Tianji Record foresight ability, Heavenly Fate Value returns to zero, become a mortal
choices.visible_reward: Completely escape Heavenly Secrets' Eye surveillance, obtain complete Tianji Record inheritance memory, unlock all of Chen Xuan's arrangements
choices.risk_hint: Once accepted, will completely lose the biggest trump card for playing against fate

dialogue.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, countless scenes flickering through his Mental Sea like a merry-go-round—the cold visage of Su Qingyao, the glance Chen Nian gave him before disappearing, Ye Qing's hand reaching out in the darkness. He suddenly opened his eyes, his voice low and resolute: "Break." One word landed, the runes on the stone door exploded violently, a golden torrent rushing into his body, colliding violently with the fourth page shackle!

text.content: Agony. Inexpressible agony. Chen Ji felt his divine soul being torn apart by invisible giant hands, the Tianji Record's rule power surged like boiling water through his meridians, the fourth page's shackle patterns began to crack and peel. At the same time, an angry roar came from the depths of the Void—that was the Heavenly Secrets' Eye, it sensed its shackle being destroyed! A vast pressure pressed down like a mountain, Chen Ji's bones almost shattered under the creaking sound, but he gritted his teeth, forcibly peeling that shackle from his divine soul, clutching it in his palm—it was a jet-black fragment, emanating a nauseating腐朽气息.

choices.description: Delay breaking the shackle, preserve the crippled prophetic ability to deal with the threats of the Demonic Path Commander and the Heavenly Secrets' Eye. Preserve trump cards, but continue being monitored.
choices.visible_cost: Continuously monitored by Heavenly Secrets' Eye, shackle continues devouring Heavenly Fate Value, ultimately cannot escape exhaustion fate
choices.visible_reward: Preserve three-hour foresight ability, continue planning in the shadows as a chess player, preserve biggest trump card
choices.risk_hint: Choosing to retain the shackle means the Eye of Heavenly Dao will continue to draw power from him, and he has already exposed himself within its vision.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's hand slowly withdrew from the stone door, his fingertips still trembling slightly. He took a deep breath, his voice hoarse: "Senior, if I choose to keep this last trace of foresight... can I still continue to play the game against fate?" Chen Xuan's divine consciousness fell silent for a moment before slowly responding: "You can. But the shackle within your body has been awakened by your previous action, and it will accelerate the erosion of your Heavenly Fate. The Eye of Heavenly Dao has already sensed you—temporary restraint might buy you time to breathe, but the time remaining for you... is running out."

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, weighing the pros and cons. Breaking the shackle meant becoming a mortal entirely, losing all capital for the game; keeping the ember meant continuing to be used as a piece by the Eye of Heavenly Dao, with each foresight feeding that terrifying existence. But at least now, he was alive, could still think, could still strategize. He opened his eyes, the corners of his mouth curving into a bitter yet cold and fierce arc: "Fine, I choose the latter. But this debt... I will eventually come to collect from the Eye of Heavenly Dao." The moment his voice fell, the runes on the stone door suddenly dimmed, and Chen Xuan's inheritance information flowed into his Mental Sea like a trickling stream—Chen Xuan's lifetime of strategic blueprints, spanning three hundred years of a chess game, had finally been handed over to him.

choices.description: A sudden wild idea struck Chen Ji—instead of passively taking blows, why not actively guide the shackle, converting the extracted Heavenly Fate Value for his own use? But this method was unheard of, and the risk was extremely high.
choices.visible_cost: Shackle loss of control could lead to soul collapse, extremely risky, success rate less than thirty percent.
choices.visible_reward: If successful, the ability to reverse-devour the power of the Eye of Heavenly Dao will be gained, Heavenly Fate Value will not decrease but increase, and the shackle will be turned into one's own use.
choices.risk_hint: This is a forbidden technique that even Chen Xuan dared not attempt—once it fails, there is no return.

dialogue.content: A spark of madness ignited in Chen Ji's eyes. "Wait—" he murmured to himself, "The shackle extracts my Heavenly Fate Value to feed to the Eye of Heavenly Dao... that means there must be a channel between us. If I could sever that channel at the moment of extraction and reverse-devour the power flowing through my body..." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul cried out in alarm: "Master! This is too dangerous! Elder Chen Xuan spent his entire life and never attempted this method!" Chen Ji smiled instead, that smile carrying a desperate resolve: "He didn't attempt it because he had complete foresight ability and didn't need to walk this tightrope. And I... have no way back."

text.content: He sat cross-legged, hands forming seals, the shackle patterns on the fourth page of the Tianji Record operating wildly within his body. Chen Ji did not resist the extraction force; instead, he actively opened his divine soul, letting that force surge in—only at the entrance of the transmission channel, he laid a web woven from divine consciousness. When the power of the Eye of Heavenly Dao surged in like a tide, Chen Ji fiercely tightened the divine consciousness web, intercepting, compressing, and refining part of the power! The agony almost tore his consciousness apart, but he gritted his teeth and held on. He didn't know how much time passed before he opened his eyes again. In his palm was a drop of pitch-black liquid—the power of the Eye of Heavenly Dao that had been intercepted and condensed into substance, cold, terrifying, yet containing astonishing energy.

The moment Chen Ji held that drop of black liquid in his palm, a cold voice exploded in his Mental Sea—this voice did not belong to Chen Xuan, did not belong to Mo Xiansheng, but came from a higher dimension, carrying irresistible authority and scrutiny. "Ant, you are playing with fire." The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice was like Heaven itself speaking, each word pressing down on Chen Ji until he could barely breathe, "Do you think that by intercepting a drop of my power, you can break free from the shackles of fate? How laughable." Chen Ji felt a vast willpower beginning to penetrate through the layers of void, approaching him. That willpower was so powerful, far surpassing Ling Yuan, far surpassing the Demonic Path commander, even far surpassing everything he had encountered before—the very willpower that governed the rules of Heaven's operation itself!

dialogue.content: Chen Ji forced himself to stand straight, facing that intangible yet omnipresent pressure, yet the corners of his mouth actually curved into a slight smile: "Playing with fire?" His voice was calm to the point of being ironic, "Since you call yourself the 'Eye of Heavenly Dao,' you should know better than me—fire, used well, provides warmth; used poorly, is self-immolation. You have laid your plans for eons, treating all seers as chess pieces, thinking this time would be no exception?" The Eye of Heavenly Dao fell silent for a moment, that pressure suddenly surging, pressing down until Chen Ji's knees buckled, almost sending him to his knees. "Interesting." Its voice carried a hint of amusement, "An ant who has not even broken through Foundation Building dares to play chess against this seat. Do you think your Tianji Record is? It's merely one of the chess pieces this seat has placed in the world, and you—are also a piece."

choice.prompt: The Eye of Heavenly Dao's pressure was like mountains collapsing, Chen Ji's qi and blood churning within him. Yet at this life-and-death moment, he suddenly sensed that within Chen Xuan's inherited strategic blueprints, there was a sealed forbidden area beginning to glow faintly—it seemed to be an undiscovered backup plan.

choices.description: Chen Ji decided to go all in, using the intercepted Heavenly Dao power to strike back against the Eye of Heavenly Dao's willpower projection. Extremely dangerous, but if successful, it would completely shatter the other's undefeated legend.
choices.visible_cost: Severe divine soul damage, possible immediate unconsciousness, Heavenly Fate Value plummeting to dangerous levels.
choices.visible_reward: If successful in repelling the Eye of Heavenly Dao's willpower projection, its control over the Tianji Record will be greatly weakened, establishing authority before Heaven.
choices.risk_hint: Using mortal power to oppose Heavenly Will, success rate less than ten percent, but the reward is an existence leap that breaks cognitive limits.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly burst into laughter, that laughter echoing in his Mental Sea, carrying a nearly insane heroism. He spread open his palm, holding that drop of intercepted Heavenly Dao power aloft: "You say I'm a chess piece? Fine—" He suddenly pressed that drop of black liquid into his brow center, "Then let this chess piece overturn your entire game board!" The Heavenly Dao power contained within the liquid was like a beast being released, rampaging through his body, colliding head-on with the Eye of Heavenly Dao's willpower projection! In that instant, Chen Ji's Mental Sea was turned upside down, he felt himself being torn apart by two diametrically opposite forces, but he gritted his teeth and bore it all.

text.content: A soundless explosion. Chen Ji stumbled back several steps, blood seeping from all seven orifices, yet his eyes burned with astonishing brightness—the Eye of Heavenly Dao's willpower projection had been forced back by him, a crack appearing in it! "You—!" The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice showed fluctuation for the first time, not anger, but disbelief. "Interesting." Its voice turned icy, "This seat remembers you, Chen Ji. Next time we meet, this seat will come personally to collect this flea." The pressure suddenly receded, and nighttime returned to silence. Chen Ji knelt on the ground, covered in blood, yet laughed wildly at the sky—he had survived before the Eye of Heavenly Dao!

choices.description: Chen Ji chose to endure, lowering his head and showing weakness before the Eye of Heavenly Dao, first preserving his life and strength, to make plans later. This aligned with his consistent strategy of playing the fool before eating the tiger.
choices.visible_cost: Complete loss of face before the Eye of Heavenly Dao, reputation damaged, but all strength preserved.
choices.visible_reward: Safe withdrawal, all strategic pieces retained, Chen Xuan's complete inheritance in hand, shackle present but partially transformed.
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao will list Chen Ji as a key focus, and his future actions will be under stricter surveillance.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly lowered his head, kneeling on one knee. His voice was calm but carried a hint of barely perceptible mockery: "The Heavenly Eye Lord speaks truly. This humble one is merely a mortal, yet to have caught your esteemed gaze is a blessing from three lifetimes." His tone was impeccable in its deference, but his fists clenched tight trembled slightly—rage and humiliation alike. "Good." The Heavenly Eye's voice betrayed no emotion whatsoever. "A wise man knows when to yield. This One grants you another chance—within three scrolls, prove you still have use. Otherwise..." A cold divine sense left a mark within Chen Ji's Mental Sea. "This One will personally erase this useless piece from the board."

text.content: The pressure receded like an ebbing tide. Chen Ji rose slowly to his feet. His robes were soaked through with cold sweat, yet a meaningful smile spread across his face. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted from the pages, voice tinged with confusion: "Master, why would you show weakness to it? With the power you just intercepted, you could clearly..." Chen Ji raised a hand to halt him, his voice low and cold: "A wolf that wishes to eat a rabbit doesn't need to reason with it. But conversely, if a rabbit wishes to survive, the smartest move is to make the wolf believe it poses absolutely no threat." He raised his gaze toward the night sky, eyes reflecting the countless stars above. "It thinks I'm a piece on the board? Fine. Then I'll be the most rebellious piece there is. By the time it discovers I've gnawed through the chessboard... it will all be too late."

Chen Ji dragged his heavy footsteps out of the Chen Xuan ruins. The night wind carried the mountain's cold breath, biting at his skin. The waterfall had resumed its raging roar, thundering as if nothing had happened. Yet the fourth-page shackle at his chest had indeed loosened—though not completely broken, the force binding his fate had been substantially weakened. More importantly, he had acquired Chen Xuan's three-hundred-year strategic blueprint—something far more valuable than any prophecy. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul whispered in his ear: "Master, you have obtained Senior Chen Xuan's core legacy. From now on, you are no longer merely a piece moved about by fate—you have gained the qualification to play chess against the Heavenly Eye at a higher dimension."

Just then, the Tianji Record's main body trembled again—not from the shackle's agitation, but from an unprecedented resonance. A golden light rose from the depths of the fragment, coalescing into a vague silhouette before Chen Ji's eyes. The silhouette resembled a projection of a scroll, emanating an ancient and sacred aura. The Tianji Record's voice sounded once more, carrying an ineffably complex emotion: "Chen Ji, I am not your enemy. Quite the opposite—I am the final insurance Chen Xuan left behind before his fall. The shackles within you are indeed connected to the Heavenly Eye, but that was never my intention. It has corroded me for far too long, leaving me powerless to break free. And you... are the first person with any hope of severing these chains."

dialogue.content: The moment the Tianji Record's words faded, the Heavenly Eye's will, which Chen Ji had struck down, coalesced once more—clearer and more oppressive than before. "Tianji Record, you think betraying This One will grant you freedom?" Its voice rang like thunder from the Nine Heavens. "What Chen Xuan could not accomplish three hundred years ago, you expect this waste to achieve?" Chen Ji raised his head to face the void, his voice steady yet resonant: "What couldn't be done three hundred years ago doesn't mean it can't be done now." He spread his hands wide. Chen Xuan's legacy diagram and the Tianji Record fragment both blazed with dazzling light. The two forces intertwined, forming an unbreakable barrier. "Heavenly Eye, listen well—I am no piece, nor am I an ant. I am Chen Ji." He spoke each word with deliberate emphasis. "The only waste in this world who knows you're playing games and still dares to call you out."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji and the Heavenly Eye's confrontation escalated to a white-hot intensity. Both waited for the other's next move. In that critical instant, Chen Ji suddenly sensed a sealed coordinate within Chen Xuan's legacy diagram pulsing violently—a final backup Chen Xuan had left behind, marking a top-secret location even the Heavenly Eye knew nothing about.

choices.description: Chen Ji activated Chen Xuan's ultimate backup—a coordinate allowing instant teleportation to "Heavenly Secrets' Shore." That place existed beyond even the Heavenly Eye's reach, the final move in Chen Xuan's three-hundred-year chess game.
choices.visible_cost: "Activating the backup will consume all energy within Chen Xuan's legacy diagram, rendering the diagram void"
choices.visible_reward: "Enter the Heavenly Forbidden Grounds, gain the possibility of transcending the shackles, and receive Chen Xuan's final legacy"
choices.risk_hint: "The Heavenly Eye may track the teleportation trace. After the diagram becomes void, Chen Xuan's布局 will lose its greatest asset"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes. His divine sense plunged into the deepest part of the legacy diagram—where a coordinate he had deliberately ignored was now pulsing frantically. He reached toward that sensing and touched it. In an instant, primordial information flooded his Mental Sea: "Heavenly Secrets' Shore, Heavenly Forbidden Grounds—only those with destiny may enter." Chen Ji's eyes snapped open. A resolute smile curved his lips: "This is it." He poured all his divine sense into that coordinate. A brilliant pillar of light descended from the sky, enveloping him! For the first time, the Heavenly Eye's voice carried shock and fury: "You dare—!"

text.content: The pillar of light tore through the night. Chen Ji felt himself being dragged by an irresistible force toward some unknown destination. The Heavenly Eye's will gripped his ankles like a giant hand, trying to yank him back from the light. The two forces clashed violently in the void. Chen Ji's body was torn apart and reformed repeatedly. Blood gushed from every pore on his body. Yet he did not let go, gripping the pillar of light for dear life. "Chen Xuan..." he howled through the agony, "what exactly did you leave me?!" At the final instant before being dragged back by the Heavenly Eye, the light pillar contracted abruptly—Chen Ji's figure vanished from the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, leaving only the Heavenly Eye's furious roar echoing through the night sky.

choices.description: Chen Ji chose not to risk activating the backup. He returned to the Tianqing Sect to gather strength quietly. Advance slowly, trade time for space, and await a better opportunity.
choices.visible_cost: "Miss the optimal timing to enter Heavenly Secrets' Shore. The shackles continue slowly eroding the Heavenly Fate"
choices.visible_reward: "Preserve Chen Xuan's legacy diagram. Rendezvous with allies like Su Qingyao and Ye Qing. Consolidate existing resources for long-term strategy"
choices.risk_hint: "The Heavenly Eye will accelerate surveillance and pressure on Chen Ji, drastically shortening the time he has to maneuver"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji withdrew his divine sense and took a deep breath, temporarily sealing that frantically pulsing coordinate in a corner of the legacy diagram. "The time isn't right yet." he murmured to himself. "Since the Heavenly Eye has revealed itself, I must not act recklessly. It wants to see my cards on the table? I refuse to play into its hands." He turned to gaze toward the Tianqing Sect, a cold glint flickering in his eyes. "Ling Yuan, the Demonic Path commander, the Heavenly Eye... all of you want to use me as a piece? Fine. Let's see how this plays out." He straightened his robes, concealing his wounds beneath a calm expression, and strode toward the sect.

text.content: By the time he returned to the sect, the sky had begun to lighten. Chen Ji had barely stepped into the Servant Disciples' courtyard when he spotted a white-robed figure standing before the gate—Su Qingyao. She held an unlit Spirit Lamp in her hand, her expression cold, though a barely concealed anxiety lurked in the depths of her eyes. Upon seeing Chen Ji's blood-soaked, disheveled state, her brow furrowed sharply: "Where have you been?" Chen Ji forced out an innocuous smile: "Night cultivation. A minor accident." Su Qingyao stared at him for a long moment, then snorted coldly and shoved a jade bottle into his hand: "Don't die out there." She turned and left, her silhouette cold as moonlight. Chen Ji clutched the warm jade bottle, watching her retreating figure. Gradually, his smile softened into something more complex.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted out, gazing toward where Su Qingyao had departed. His voice carried a rare note of sentiment: "Master, this woman... she is truly extraordinary. She knows you harbor unspeakable secrets, yet she chooses to protect rather than expose." Chen Ji looked down at the jade bottle in his palm, silent for a long while. "I know." His voice was soft, so gentle it seemed afraid to disturb anything. "That's why... I cannot afford to lose." He tucked the jade bottle close to his chest, turned, and walked into his room. The moment the door closed, his gaze turned deep and cold once more. Outside the window, the first rays of dawn pierced through the clouds, falling upon his shoulders. A new day had begun, and his chess game was only just entering its true middle phase.

Meanwhile, at a height beyond Chen Ji's perception, a pair of eyes condensed entirely from Heavenly Dao laws gazed through endless void, quietly observing the direction of the Tianqing Sect. Those eyes had no pupils, only endless cycles of reincarnation and karmic因果 revolving within. It saw every choice Chen Ji made, and the certain power awakening within him. "Interesting." The Heavenly Eye's voice reverberated through the void, carrying a gaze that transcended good and evil. "The seed Chen Xuan left behind has finally begun to sprout." Its voice suddenly turned ice-cold and menacing. "Then... it is time to add more fuel to the fire." An invisible will penetrated countless layers of reality, racing toward a certain direction—the direction of the Demonic Path Holy Sect, where a certain existence imprisoned for many years slumbered. And that existence's name was "Heavenly Fate Lock Key."

dialogue.content: Just as the Heavenly Eye's will was about to reach the Demonic Path Holy Sect, an elderly yet majestic voice suddenly sounded in its ear—a warning from the deepest rules of Heavenly Dao operation. "Enough." That voice contained only a single word, yet it brought all of the Heavenly Eye's actions to an abrupt halt. "This piece still has observation value. Interfere any earlier, and the balance will be broken." The Heavenly Eye fell silent for a long while before finally harrumphing dismissively: "Balance? Hmph." Its will slowly receded, but that final gaze lingered on Chen Ji for precisely three breaths. Three breaths later, the void returned to silence. Only a wisp of ethereal Heavenly Dao aura remained, quietly clinging to the residual patterns of the Tianji Record's fourth-page shackles—the Heavenly Eye's final ultimatum, and its formal declaration of war against this "ant" called Chen Ji.
